tips.title: Pack with Care
tips.body: Click an item to pack it. Pad the fragile things before they go in a box. A scuff or a chip only nicks the tip, never the base pay.

tips.title: Load the Truck
tips.body: Carry each box to the truck and set it on a mustard floor slot. Heavy boxes belong on the floor. The back door swings open when you are ready to roll.

tips.title: A Gentle Drive
tips.body: WASD or the arrow keys drive. H honks. The rainy route is a short loop with ducks, puddles, and a closed bridge. You cannot fail a drive.

tips.title: Unpack & Place
tips.body: Click a box to open it, then click the floor, a desk, or the top of another item. A red ghost means it would float or overlap. R rotates 90 degrees. Hold Shift and press R for 15 degrees. G toggles the 0.25 m grid. Free placement is the default. Wall pieces sit 0.12 m off the wall, then settle with a soft thunk.

tips.title: Pay & Tips
tips.body: Base pay is always paid in full. Damage only comes out of the tip. Mend a scuff, or keep it. Nothing you packed is ever lost.

tips.title: Trade on the Computer
tips.body: The beige computer opens HomeDesk. Buy and sell office goods on the market, read Marge's mail, and check listings. Prices move when the day advances.

tips.title: Make It Yours
tips.body: Spend what you earn on decor and place it in the room. TropicalForest delivers to the door. Pop the bubble wrap, then find the item a spot.

tips.title: No Rush, No Fail
tips.body: Esc pauses and saves. Take the day at your own pace. A bumpy drive, a scuffed box, or an empty shop never ends the game.
